newsitem.title: USA: EIS Intl named in lawsuit -- law firm.
newsitem.headline: EIS Intl named in lawsuit -- law firm.

text.p: EIS International Inc was named in a lawsuit filed in U.S. District Court of Connecticut on behalf of shareholders who purchased the stock, two law firms said in a joint statement.

Schoengold & Sporn PC, of New York City, and MacMillan & Lucas of Stamford, Conn., filed the case against the company, claiming that the company and its executives misled investors about the company's operations and acquisitions it had made, the law firms said.
The lawsuit has been brought on behalf of all persons who purchased EIS common stock during the period November 28, 1995 through and including March 31, 1997, the law firms said.
EIS was not immediately available for comment.
